title: High Plains Hot Air Balloon Company

services.name: My First Balloon Ride
services.desc: We are a hot air balloon ride company located in Mitchell, Nebraska. Our mission is to provide you the experience of a lifetime. We are a Husband and Wife pilot team, Mike and Colleen Johnson. Experience the beauty of flying in the valley along the North Platte River. You might spot one of the many species of birds that live in our area, bald eagles, hawks, red cardinals, pheasant, or quail. The white tailed deer are abundant and often swim across the river under the balloon basket while flying. Whether you are booking a private flight for two, or a flight with five friends. We guarantee a wonderful time with champagne toast and ceremony at the end of each flight. Private Hot Air Balloon
